title: player
description: A player is a participant who makes choices within the rules of a game; the game's outcome depends, at least partly, on their choices. A spectator watches, a referee enforces, a player decides.

choicesAffectOutcome.description: The defining condition: participants whose choices do not affect the game state are spectators or officials, not players.

role.description: The player's position in the game's structure — symmetric competitor, teammate, narrator, dealer; asymmetric roles are still players when their choices affect the state.

voluntary.description: Whether the player chose to enter; compelled participation changes the relation between participant and activity (see ./game.schema.json voluntariness).
